name: Pocket Invoice MCP
description: Hosted MCP for invoices, estimates, quotes, receipts, purchase orders and PDF export. Uses saved customers, items, payment records and unpaid balances. Streamable HTTP and OAuth; Codex verified. Records shared with web, iOS and Android under company permissions. Currently free; account document and storage limits apply. Email is disabled by default and each send needs confirmation. No card charging, transfers or refunds. Other clients need remote MCP and OAuth support.
